errors.text_span: with tick labels at intervals of 0.1 and 0.2, respectively
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the y-axis tick intervals for the two plots. The top plot has intervals of 0.2, and the bottom plot has intervals of 0.1, not the other way around.
In the top plot, the Llama-On-Policy-Easy line (blue) reaches a value of approximately 0.2 at step 100, not 0.3.
In the top plot, the Llama-LUFFY-Easy line (red) reaches a value of approximately 0.2 at step 100, not 0.25.
In the bottom plot, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard line (blue) starts at a value of approximately 0.02-0.03, not at 0.0.
The description fails to mention the shaded areas around the lines, which represent confidence intervals or variance and are a significant feature of the plot.
